  body: {
    title: 'Jon\'s Meeting',
    location: 'Office 123',
    overview: 'Overview of meeting',
    is_private: true,
    conclusion: 'My conclusion',
    is_draft: false,
    time_zone: 'US/Pacific',
    remote_meeting_url: 'https://zoom.us/j/123456789',
    start_time: '10:00 AM',
    finish_time: '11:00 AM',
    meeting_template_id: '82593',
    custom_textfield_1: 'My custom text field',
    custom_textarea_1: 'My custom text area',
    position: 6,
    attendees: [1, 2],
    attendee_minutes_approvers: [1],
    create_uncategorized_items_category: false,
    meeting_date: '2025-07-22',
    starts_at: '2025-07-22T14:00:00Z',
    ends_at: '2025-07-22T15:00:00Z',
    view: 'mobile',
    attachment_ids: ['1', '2'],
    drawing_revision_ids: ['3', '4'],
    file_version_ids: ['5', '6'],
    form_ids: ['7', '8'],
    image_ids: ['9', '10'],
    upload_ids: ['01J15GF28TDQ2X20RNRJ5DDX27', '01J15GFDKQ4TDRBQPZ2M6E9H44'],
    prostore_file_ids: [1, 2],
    document_management_document_revision_ids: ['13', '14']
  },
  json: true
};

request(options, function (error, response, body) {
  if (error) throw new Error(error);

  console.log(body);
});
